episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the current trends in the luxury real estate market, emphasizing the importance of pricing strategy and understanding client needs. She also explores the role of AI in enhancing real estate practices and shares insights on maintaining client relationships through social media engagement.
